title: Special Fusions

blocks.text: This section covers all Special Fusions and how to fuse them. Special Fusions are fusions that require a specific combination of Personas. Some Special Fusions require a Cross, Pentagon, or Hexagon Spread while others only need a Normal or Triangle Spread. The Special Fusions below are listed alphabetically.
Pazuzu + Belphegor + Belial + Mot + Seth + Baal Zebul
Jack Frost + Pyro Jack + King Frost + Pixie + Ghoul
Ares + Triglav + Kin-ki + Atavaka + Neko Shogun
Ananta + Anubis + Trumpeter + Michael + Satan + Metatron
Matador + White Rider + Mother Harlot + Daisoujou + Hell Biker + Trumpeter
Saki Mitama + Ara Mitama + Kusi Mitama + Nigi Mitama
